grounding.excerpt: The permittee shall achieve compliance with the Cyanide effluent limitations specified for
Achieve Final Effluent Limitations 12 months after permit effective date
This permit shall become effective on December 1, 2021. This permit and the authorization to discharge shall expire at midnight, November 30, 2026.

payload.rationale: Part I requires achieving final Cyanide effluent limitations 12 months after the permit effective date. The cover page establishes the effective date as December 1, 2021, so the compliance-schedule completion date is December 1, 2022. Under the relation contract, final numeric cyanide limits apply in a period once that completion date has passed. FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30) lies entirely after December 1, 2022, so the final limit schedule applies during FY2025.
